description: NSE equity-segment trading holidays on weekdays. Weekends are always non-trading days and are not listed. Used by tools/stale_data_check.py to work out the last completed trading session.
source: NSE circular 'Trading holidays for the calendar year 2026' (equity and equity derivatives segments), https://www.nseindia.com/resources/exchange-communication-holidays. Cross-checked against published broker copies of the list, Oct 2026.
maintenance: NSE usually publishes the next year's list in December. Add it under 'holidays' and in 'publishedYears' as soon as it is out. Until then, years missing from 'publishedYears' are treated as having no holidays, and the check says so in its output. The Muhurat session (Sunday 2026-11-08) is a special session and is not a regular daily refresh, so it is not listed.
